claims.text: UNHCR's Operational Data Portal for the Sudan situation records Total Forcibly Displaced at 11,431,220 (last updated 06 July 2026), comprising 6,597,438 IDPs inside Sudan (last updated 15 June 2026), 273,081 self-relocated refugees in Sudan (last updated 06 July 2026), and 4,560,701 total newly arrived refugees, asylum-seekers and returnees outside Sudan (last updated 06 July 2026).

Re-checked 8 August 2026 via direct fetch: UNHCR's Operational Data Portal for the Sudan situation now shows 'Total Forcibly Displaced: 11,344,665', labeled 'Last updated 03 Aug 2026' -- up from 11,336,565 (20 July 2026 update). The portal breaks this down as 6,490,949 IDPs within Sudan (last updated 20 Jul 2026), 273,081 self-relocated refugees in Sudan (last updated 06 Jul 2026), and 4,580,635 newly arrived refugees, asylum-seekers and returnees outside Sudan (last updated 03 Aug 2026). UNHCR continues to describe Sudan as the world's largest displacement, humanitarian and protection crisis.

Re-checked 9 August 2026: UNHCR's Operational Data Portal for the Sudan situation could not be independently re-confirmed today due to client-side rendering; the last confirmed figure, Total Forcibly Displaced: 11,344,665 (last updated 3 August 2026), stands unchanged pending the next successful check.

Re-checked 11 August 2026: UNHCR's Operational Data Portal for the Sudan situation remains JS-rendered and its summary statistics were not directly extractable by automated fetch; the portal's document library shows a 'Sudan Situation Map Weekly Regional Update' dated 3 August 2026 as its most recent visible weekly update, consistent with no change since the last confirmed figure, Total Forcibly Displaced: 11,344,665 (last updated 3 August 2026). No newer aggregate total-displaced figure was found via UNHCR or ReliefWeb searches.

Re-checked 12 August 2026: UNHCR's Operational Data Portal for the Sudan situation remains client-side rendered and its summary statistics could not be extracted by automated fetch again today. A check of UNHCR's country page for Sudan (data.unhcr.org/en/country/sdn, last updated 31 July 2026) shows a broader all-time cumulative IDP figure (8,685,273, combining 2.19M pre-April-2023 and 6.49M post-April-2023 displacement) that uses a different denominator than the situation portal's 'Total Forcibly Displaced' metric this record tracks, so it is noted as context rather than adopted as a revision. The last verified aggregate remains 11,344,665 total forcibly displaced, last updated 3 August 2026.

Re-checked 13 August 2026: UNHCR's Operational Data Portal for the Sudan situation still shows 'Total Forcibly Displaced: 11,344,665' (last updated 3 Aug 2026); no newer weekly regional update or ReliefWeb Population Movements report has been published. UN News (12 August 2026) reports fresh localized displacement (~15,000 families to El Obeid over three weeks; 2,500 displaced in Blue Nile) consistent with the crisis continuing, but no revised nationwide aggregate. Total remains unchanged.

Re-checked 14 August 2026: UNHCR's Operational Data Portal for the Sudan situation remains client-side rendered and its summary statistics could not be extracted by automated fetch; a search for a newer 'Population Movements from Sudan' ReliefWeb report still returns 6 July 2026 as the latest dated edition found. The last verified figure, Total Forcibly Displaced: 11,344,665 (last updated 3 August 2026), remains unchanged.
UNHCR describes the Sudan situation as the world's largest displacement, humanitarian and protection crisis.

ReliefWeb's 'Population Movements from Sudan' report (06 July 2026) corroborates UNHCR's Operational Data Portal total of 11,431,220 forcibly displaced as the most current published figure; no later aggregate total-displaced update had been published as of 17 July 2026.
UNHCR's Operational Data Portal for the Sudan situation now records Total Forcibly Displaced at 11,336,565 (last updated 20 July 2026), down from the prior 11,431,220 figure (06 July 2026 update).

Re-checked 1 August 2026: UNHCR's Operational Data Portal for the Sudan situation has not published an update newer than the 20 July 2026 figure (11,336,565 total forcibly displaced); the portal's dashboard is JS-rendered and no comparable newer aggregate figure was found via other UNHCR pages.

Re-checked 2 August 2026: UNHCR's Operational Data Portal for the Sudan situation still shows Total Forcibly Displaced at 11,336,565, last updated 20 July 2026; no newer portal update has been published as of 2 August 2026.

Re-checked 5 August 2026: UNHCR's Operational Data Portal for the Sudan situation still shows Total Forcibly Displaced at 11,336,565, last updated 20 July 2026; the page's dashboard total remains JS-rendered and not directly extractable by automated fetch, but the most recent document visible on the portal (a Chad country update dated 30 June 2026, published 3 August 2026) confirms the portal is current and no newer Sudan-wide aggregate has superseded the 20 July figure.

Re-checked 6 August 2026: UNHCR's Operational Data Portal for the Sudan situation still shows Total Forcibly Displaced at 11,336,565, last updated 20 July 2026; no newer portal update has been published as of 6 August 2026.

Re-checked 7 August 2026 via direct fetch: UNHCR's Operational Data Portal for the Sudan situation still shows 'Total Forcibly Displaced: 11,336,565', labeled 'Last updated 20 Jul 2026' -- unchanged from the figure on file.

description: The conflict that erupted in Sudan in April 2023 between the Sudanese Armed Forces and the Rapid Support Forces has produced what UNHCR calls the world's largest displacement crisis, forcing millions from their homes inside Sudan and into neighbouring countries.
